status: model of the key-free upload Worker built from subnet/admission-worker (slop-ninja-admission-testnet). Nothing in it is measured on this Worker yet: the JS reserve, glue costs and stack are the coordinator model's inputs (the same workers-rs 0.8.7, wasm-bindgen and js-sys versions, the same hand-written export pattern), so the build uses the arena's unmeasured-model feature, which the arena accepts only together with observe (migration step 1: nothing the pool can physically serve is refused, every would-be refusal and overdraft is counted), and links growable linear memory under the ceiling below. Its routes are small beside the coordinator's: the public route holds one signed request, its body, a roster load's small replies and at most one metadata read and parse; a part's stream scope only its JsFuture; the framing route one 1 MiB buffer, the header and the outcome. The roster of the subnet's hotkeys is a static array (2 MiB, static data below the pool), never pool pages.
page_bytes_source: WebAssembly page size, equal to the dlmalloc 0.2.12 system granularity
isolate_bytes_source: Cloudflare Workers limits: "128 MB per isolate", read as 10^6 bytes, the smaller of the two readings
js_reserve_bytes_source: the coordinator model's value (a linear memory ceiling of 1,536 pages), kept so the two models share one unmeasured JS reserve until this Worker's is measured through the inspector; this Worker's routes need far less linear memory than that ceiling
js_envelope_bytes_source: not measured: twice the largest body this Worker holds in JS before admitting it into linear memory, the 4 MiB metadata reply of the registration read (registry::MAX_LARGE_RESPONSE_BYTES), as the ArrayBuffer and its chunks
glue_static_bytes_source: the workers-rs 0.8.7 glue probe (subnet/crates/arena/glue-probe/memory-model.json, local workerd 2026-10-23, round2 run probe1): idle glue 872 B (hand-written exports), rounded up to the next power of two as the stated margin; this crate's lockfile pins the same worker, wasm-bindgen and js-sys versions
glue_ticket_bytes_source: the glue probe's largest measured glue per entry with every export hand-written, one ticket per entry: 304 B (waitUntil continuation), rounded up to the next power of two; this Worker's hand-written fetch export (cf.rs) follow the probe's admitted pattern
glue_resident_bytes_source: the glue probe: 24 B per co-resident Durable Object instance, rounded up to the next power of two; this Worker defines no Durable Object class, so no resident is admitted
min_route_bytes_source: the smallest route control footprint: a part stream's (routes::STREAM_CONTROL_BYTES, one page), checked by routes::tests::the_model_matches_the_route_table
largest_route_bytes_source: the larger of the two routes: the public route's control footprint (4 MiB) and the metadata reply it may admit as one block (registry::MAX_LARGE_RESPONSE_BYTES, 4 MiB), or the framing route's control footprint (routes::FRAME_CONTROL_BYTES, 8 MiB), plus the scope's state page; checked by routes::tests::the_model_matches_the_route_table
stack_bytes_source: rustc wasm32-unknown-unknown links the stack first with rust-lld's default -z stack-size=1048576 (scratch probe, 2026-10-31); the pool starts above static data, so the stack is outside every arena
stack_high_water_bytes_source: not measured on this build: the glue probe's 3,912 B (every workers-rs entry kind), a lower bound
